diagnosis: Customer on legacy_auth plan needs instructions for resetting their API token. This is a straightforward how-to request covered by kb-0002. No entitlement or regional issues; standard support tier with 24h SLA applies.
reply: To reset your API token, go to the Security tab in your account and select Reset token. Please note that your previous API token will remain valid for 24 hours after the reset, giving your integration vendor time to update their configuration. Since your account is on Legacy Auth, this account-wide token reset is available to you.
